title: Paciente kaq
intro: Unayñan, runaq qallariy p’unchayninkunapi, iskay almakuna Kamaqninkuq ñawpaqenpi sayasharqanku ofrendakunawan. Hukninmi chaskisqa karqan, huknintaq mana. Qatiqninqa wawqi-panipura ñawpaq hatun llakikuymi kanman karqan - huk pacienciawan hark'akuywan huk k'arak vengakuywan. ¿Atiwaqchu sut’inchayta pi kasqayta?
clues: Kay pachapi runa kausay qallariy p’unchaykunapiraqmi nacerqani
Ñuqaqa kay pachapi puriq ñawpaq iskay runap wawan karqani
Huk kutinmi ovejaymanta allin kaq sacrificiota haywarqani Kamaqniyta kusichinaypaq
Ofrendayta hanaqmanta chaskirqanku, wawqeypa ofrendantataq mana chaskirqankuchu
Wañuchinaypaq amenazawaptinkum, wawqiy contra makiyta mana hoqarinaypaq akllakurqani
Runakunapa historianpi punta kaq runam karqani, hukpa mana allin wañuchisqan

outcome.label: Tukusqa
options: Runakunapa historianpi punta kaq wañuchisqa runam karqa
Maderamanta ruwasqa buque ukhupi hatun unu hunt’aykusqanmantan kawsarqan
Tawa chunka watañam hatun chunniqpi purirqani
outcome.answer: Runakunapa historianpi punta kaq wañuchisqa runam karqa

arabic: ۞ وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ ٱبْنَىْ ءَادَمَ بِٱلْحَقِّ إِذْ قَرَّبَا قُرْبَانًۭا فَتُقُبِّلَ مِنْ أَحَدِهِمَا وَلَمْ يُتَقَبَّلْ مِنَ ٱلْـَٔاخَرِ قَالَ لَأَقْتُلَنَّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّمَا يَتَقَبَّلُ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verse: And recite to them the story of Adam's two sons, in truth, when they both made an offering [to Allāh], and it was accepted from one of them but was not accepted from the other. Said [the latter], "I will surely kill you." Said [the former], "Indeed, Allāh only accepts from the righteous [who fear Him]. (5:27)
